senses.en: Become faster, or make something happen faster.

ex.en: I quickened my pace when the rain started.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，我加快了脚步。

ex.en: Improved transport links can quicken the pace of economic development by connecting rural producers with urban markets.
ex.zh: 改善交通联系可以将农村生产者与城市市场连接起来，从而加快经济发展的步伐。

tip: 可及物或不及物，常搭配pace、pulse。

senses.en: an officially fixed amount allowed, required, or assigned

ex.en: Our team reached its monthly sales quota yesterday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们团队昨天下午完成了本月的销售指标。

ex.en: Fishing quotas can protect marine populations, provided that governments monitor catches and enforce the limits consistently.
ex.zh: 只要政府监测捕捞量并始终严格执行限额，捕捞配额就能保护海洋生物种群。

col: meet a quota｜完成配额指标
tip: 既可指允许的上限，也可指必须完成的指标。

senses.en: to receive results or rewards from previous actions
to cut and gather a crop when it is ready

ex.en: After months of practice, she finally reaped the rewards.
ex.zh: 经过几个月的练习，她终于收获了回报。

ex.en: Countries that invest consistently in early education often reap long-term economic and social benefits.
ex.zh: 持续投资幼儿教育的国家往往能获得长期的经济和社会效益。

tip: 抽象义常搭配benefits或rewards，强调付出后的收获。

senses.en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish

senses.zh: 促成某结果的方法或因素
senses.en: a method or situation likely to produce a particular result

ex.en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
ex.zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。

ex.en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。

col: follow a recipe｜按照食谱做菜
a recipe for success｜成功之道
a recipe for disaster｜招致灾难的做法
tip: recipe指做菜方法；menu是菜单，prescription是处方。

senses.en: Ignoring danger or the possible harmful results of an action

ex.en: Cycling downhill without brakes was a reckless thing to do.
ex.zh: 骑着没有刹车的自行车下坡是一种鲁莽的行为。

ex.en: Reckless lending by financial institutions can expose households to debts they have little realistic chance of repaying.
ex.zh: 金融机构不顾风险地放贷，可能让家庭背上几乎无力偿还的债务。

col: reckless disregard for safety｜对安全的肆意漠视
tip: 比careless更强调明知有风险仍不顾后果。

senses.en: To make conflicting ideas, needs, or facts compatible
To restore friendly relations after a disagreement
To help someone accept an unpleasant situation

ex.en: We reconciled our different tastes by choosing a buffet.
ex.zh: 我们选择了自助餐，兼顾了彼此不同的口味。

ex.en: Governments must reconcile the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect valuable green spaces.
ex.zh: 政府必须协调可负担住房需求与保护宝贵绿地的需要。

col: reconcile A with B｜使A与B协调
be reconciled with someone｜与某人和解
tip: 协调两者用with；接受现实用reconcile oneself to。

senses.en: the return of an event, problem, or illness

ex.en: Regular stretching may help prevent a recurrence of back pain.
ex.zh: 经常做拉伸运动可能有助于防止背痛复发。

ex.en: Improved drainage systems could reduce the risk of a recurrence of severe flooding in urban areas.
ex.zh: 改善排水系统可以降低城市地区再次发生严重洪灾的风险。

col: prevent a recurrence｜防止再次发生
tip: 常接 of；疾病复发和问题重现都可用。

senses.zh: 深思熟虑的；反映的，反射的

senses.en: The process of officially recording details or joining something.
An official document showing that something has been registered.

ex.en: Registration for the swimming course opens on Monday.
ex.zh: 游泳课程将于周一开始报名。

ex.en: Online registration can improve access to public services, provided that support remains available for people without internet access.
ex.zh: 网上登记可以让公共服务更易获取，前提是仍为无法上网的人提供帮助。

tip: 表示报名或注册某活动，常用registration for。

senses.en: payment given back for money someone has spent

ex.en: Keep your train ticket to claim reimbursement from work.
ex.zh: 保留火车票，以便向单位申请报销。

ex.en: Providing reimbursement for travel expenses can make professional training more accessible to employees from low-income households.
ex.zh: 报销差旅费用可以让来自低收入家庭的员工更容易获得职业培训机会。

tip: 多指已付费用的报销，不泛指偿还贷款。

senses.en: No longer worried because something unpleasant has ended or been avoided

ex.en: I felt relieved when I finally found my keys.
ex.zh: 终于找到钥匙时，我松了一口气。

ex.en: Residents were relieved to hear that the local hospital would remain open despite proposed budget cuts.
ex.zh: 尽管有人提议削减预算，居民听说当地医院仍将继续运营，都松了一口气。

col: relieved to hear｜听到后感到放心
tip: 常用be relieved to do或be relieved that从句。

senses.en: Unwillingness or hesitation to do something.

ex.en: With obvious reluctance, Leo handed his favourite toy back.
ex.zh: 利奥明显很不情愿地把心爱的玩具还了回去。

ex.en: Some commuters show reluctance to use public transport because services are infrequent and unreliable.
ex.zh: 一些通勤者不愿乘坐公共交通，因为班次稀少且不可靠。

col: overcome one's reluctance｜克服不情愿的心理
tip: 通常不可数，常接to do，表示不愿做某事。

senses.en: The process by which living things produce young.
The process of copying an image, sound, or other material.
A copy of an original object or artwork.

ex.en: We watched a documentary about reproduction in sea turtles.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于海龟繁殖的纪录片。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures may disrupt reproduction in marine species, threatening the long-term stability of coastal ecosystems.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升可能扰乱海洋物种的繁殖，威胁沿海生态系统的长期稳定。

col: a reproduction of a painting｜一幅画的复制品
tip: 指繁殖或复制过程时不可数；指一件复制品时可数。

senses.en: An occasion when people meet again after time apart.

ex.en: Our family reunion filled the garden with laughter.
ex.zh: 我们的家庭聚会让花园里充满了欢笑。

ex.en: School reunions can strengthen social connections and encourage former students to support their local communities.
ex.zh: 校友聚会能够加强社会联系，并鼓励往届学生支持当地社区。

tip: 强调分别后的再相聚，不泛指任何聚会。

senses.en: to become active or popular again, or make something so
to regain consciousness or energy, or help someone do so

ex.en: Our neighbours hope to revive the annual street party.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居希望恢复一年一度的街头聚会。

ex.en: Investment in public transport could revive declining town centres by making local businesses more accessible.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以让人们更方便地光顾当地商家，从而振兴衰落的城镇中心。

col: revive interest in｜重新激起对……的兴趣
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：revive a tradition；hopes revive。

senses.en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement
providing substantial financial benefits

ex.en: Teaching my little cousin to swim was surprisingly rewarding.
ex.zh: 教我的小表弟游泳，出乎意料地让我很有成就感。

ex.en: Volunteering can be a rewarding experience that develops practical skills and strengthens connections within local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿服务可以是一段有意义的经历，既能培养实用技能，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

tip: 多指带来满足感；强调赚钱可加financially。

senses.zh: 作为仪式一部分的； 例行的

senses.en: Stealing from a person or place using force or threats.

ex.en: The shop closed early after a robbery yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天发生抢劫后，这家商店提前关门了。

ex.en: Better street lighting may reduce the risk of robbery and help residents feel safer after dark.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可能降低抢劫风险，让居民在天黑后更有安全感。

tip: robbery涉及暴力或威胁；theft泛指盗窃。

senses.en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.
A smell left behind that an animal can follow.
To detect something by its smell.

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

ex.en: The scent of flowers can attract pollinators, helping many plant species reproduce and maintain healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 花香可以吸引传粉动物，帮助许多植物繁殖，并维持健康的生态系统。

col: follow a scent｜循着气味追踪
tip: scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。

senses.en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials
the art of creating solid forms from materials

ex.en: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands outside the library.
ex.zh: 图书馆外矗立着一座马的青铜雕塑。

ex.en: Public sculpture can strengthen a city's cultural identity while making art accessible to people outside traditional galleries.
ex.zh: 公共雕塑能增强城市的文化认同，同时让传统美术馆之外的人们也能接触艺术。

tip: 指艺术门类不可数；指一件作品可数。

senses.en: Protected from direct sunlight by trees or other objects.
Seeming dishonest or possibly involved in illegal activities.

ex.en: We found a shady spot beneath the old oak.
ex.zh: 我们在老橡树下找到了一处阴凉的地方。

ex.en: Planting trees along busy streets creates shady spaces that encourage walking during hot weather.
ex.zh: 在繁忙街道两旁种树可以创造阴凉空间，鼓励人们在炎热天气里步行。

tip: shady指背阴或可疑；shadowy多指昏暗、模糊。

senses.en: A person who looks after sheep
To guide people carefully in a particular direction

ex.en: The shepherd led the sheep home before sunset.
ex.zh: 牧羊人在日落前把羊群领回了家。

ex.en: Museum staff shepherd visitors through crowded galleries to ensure that everyone can move safely between exhibits.
ex.zh: 博物馆工作人员引导游客穿过拥挤的展厅，确保所有人都能在展品之间安全通行。

col: a shepherd's hut｜牧羊人的小屋
shepherd visitors through｜引导游客穿过
tip: 作动词通常及物：shepherd sb into/through某处。

senses.en: good at judging situations and making decisions that bring advantages

ex.en: That shrewd purchase saved us money on heating.
ex.zh: 那次明智的购买为我们节省了取暖费用。

ex.en: Shrewd investment in renewable energy can help governments reduce future costs while improving national energy security.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源进行精明投资，可以帮助政府降低未来成本，同时提升国家能源安全。

col: a shrewd investor｜精明的投资者
tip: 强调判断精明、善于谋利，不等于单纯聪明。

senses.zh: 短程往返接驳交通工具
senses.en: a vehicle making frequent trips between two places
a spacecraft designed for repeated journeys into space
to travel or carry people repeatedly between places

ex.en: We took the free shuttle from the airport to our hotel.
ex.zh: 我们从机场乘免费接驳车去了酒店。

ex.en: Regular shuttle services between railway stations and business parks could reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 火车站与商业园区之间的定期接驳服务可以减少人们对私家车的依赖。

tip: 交通语境中强调两地间往返；航天飞机用space shuttle。

senses.en: to mean something or be a sign of it
to make a feeling or intention known through an action

ex.en: These dark clouds usually signify that rain is coming.
ex.zh: 这些乌云通常意味着快要下雨了。

ex.en: Rising literacy rates may signify improvements in educational access, especially among previously disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 识字率上升可能意味着受教育机会有所改善，尤其是在原本处于弱势的群体中。

tip: signify较正式，常接名词或that从句。

senses.en: happening or existing at exactly the same time

ex.en: Simultaneous cheers erupted from both sides of the street.
ex.zh: 街道两边同时爆发出欢呼声。

ex.en: Simultaneous investment in public transport and cycling infrastructure can reduce congestion more effectively than isolated measures.
ex.zh: 同时投资公共交通和自行车基础设施，比采取单一措施更能有效缓解交通拥堵。

tip: 强调时间重合；副词simultaneously表示同时地。

senses.en: To leave something out or not do something expected.
To move with light hops or jump over a swinging rope.

ex.en: I skipped breakfast because I woke up too late.
ex.zh: 我起得太晚，所以没吃早餐。

ex.en: Students who regularly skip classes may struggle to develop the knowledge required for more advanced courses.
ex.zh: 经常缺课的学生可能难以掌握学习更高阶课程所需的知识。

col: skip a step｜跳过一个步骤
tip: skip后直接接宾语；skipped、skipping须双写p。

senses.en: An extremely tall building with many floors.

ex.en: The skyscraper cast a long shadow across the park.
ex.zh: 那座摩天大楼在公园里投下了一道长长的影子。

ex.en: Building skyscrapers can accommodate growing urban populations, but cities must also invest in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 建造摩天大楼可以容纳不断增长的城市人口，但城市也必须投资建设可靠的公共交通。

col: build a skyscraper｜建造摩天大楼
glass skyscraper｜玻璃幕墙摩天大楼
tip: 比普通high-rise更强调极高的建筑。

senses.en: loose rather than tightly stretched
less busy, active, or careful than expected
looseness in a rope, or unused capacity

ex.en: The tent rope was slack after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨过后，帐篷的绳子松了。

ex.en: When demand is slack, manufacturers may reduce working hours rather than dismiss experienced employees immediately.
ex.zh: 需求疲软时，制造商可能会缩短工作时间，而不是立即解雇有经验的员工。

col: take up the slack｜收紧松弛部分；补位
tip: slack指松弛或懈怠；slacks是宽松长裤。

senses.zh: 砍， 砍痕； 斜线号

senses.en: To move goods or people secretly and against the rules.

ex.en: Someone tried to smuggle rare birds through the airport.
ex.zh: 有人试图通过机场偷运珍稀鸟类。

ex.en: Stronger international cooperation is needed to stop criminal groups that smuggle endangered animals across national borders.
ex.zh: 需要加强国际合作，以阻止跨境走私濒危动物的犯罪团伙。

col: smuggle something into a country｜将某物走私入境
smuggle something across a border｜跨境偷运某物
tip: 常用smuggle sth into/out of某地，表示偷运进出。

senses.en: A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.

ex.en: Check the specifications before buying a new laptop.
ex.zh: 买新笔记本电脑前，先查看规格参数。

ex.en: Clear building specifications help ensure that new housing meets safety standards and uses energy efficiently.
ex.zh: 明确的建筑技术要求有助于确保新住房符合安全标准并高效利用能源。

tip: 谈产品各项参数常用复数specifications，可简称specs。

senses.zh: 演出， 场面； 景象， 壮观； 眼镜

senses.en: easy to understand or do, without complications
honest and direct in expressing thoughts or intentions

ex.en: The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
ex.zh: 这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。

ex.en: Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.
ex.zh: 政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。

col: a straightforward answer｜直截了当的回答
tip: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。

senses.zh: 走失，迷路；分心，走神；离题
迷路的，走失的；孤立的，零星的

senses.en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions
hit someone or something with force
occur suddenly to someone or create a strong impression

ex.en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
ex.zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。

ex.en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
ex.zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。

col: strike someone as unusual｜让某人觉得不寻常
tip: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

senses.en: Money provided to support activities or keep prices lower.

ex.en: A government subsidy helped us install solar panels at home.
ex.zh: 政府补贴帮助我们在家里安装了太阳能板。

ex.en: Targeted subsidies for public transport can make commuting more affordable while encouraging people to use their cars less.
ex.zh: 针对公共交通的定向补贴能降低通勤费用，同时鼓励人们减少开车。

tip: 可数名词，复数为subsidies；常与for搭配。

senses.en: Small or delicate enough to be difficult to notice
Expressed or achieved indirectly and skilfully

ex.en: The soup has a subtle hint of lemon.
ex.zh: 这汤带有一丝淡淡的柠檬味。

ex.en: Advertising can exert a subtle influence on consumers by associating products with desirable lifestyles.
ex.zh: 广告将产品与令人向往的生活方式联系起来，从而潜移默化地影响消费者。

tip: b不发音；常形容难以察觉的差别或影响。

senses.en: A person who oversees other people's work or activities.
An academic who guides a student's research.

ex.en: My supervisor showed me how to use the equipment.
ex.zh: 我的主管教我如何使用这些设备。

ex.en: A supportive supervisor can help new employees develop confidence and adapt to unfamiliar workplace expectations.
ex.zh: 支持员工的主管能帮助新员工建立信心，并适应不熟悉的工作要求。

tip: 职场中指主管；英国大学中也常指研究导师。

senses.en: To give evidence in court about what you know
To provide evidence that something is true or exists

ex.en: She agreed to testify about the accident she witnessed.
ex.zh: 她同意就自己目睹的事故作证。

ex.en: Residents were invited to testify in court about the effects of industrial pollution on their health.
ex.zh: 居民受邀出庭，就工业污染对其健康的影响作证。

col: testify against someone｜作出不利于某人的证词
tip: testify that接从句；testify to接名词或动名词。

senses.zh: 证词； 见证， 证明

senses.en: The way a surface or substance feels or looks.

ex.en: This blanket has a soft texture that feels lovely.
ex.zh: 这条毯子质地柔软，摸起来很舒服。

ex.en: The texture of recycled materials can influence whether consumers find sustainable products attractive.
ex.zh: 再生材料的质地会影响消费者是否觉得可持续产品有吸引力。

tip: 既可描述材料的触感，也可描述食物的口感。

senses.en: the level at which something starts happening or changes
the bottom edge of a doorway
the point just before a new experience or period begins

ex.en: My brother has a much higher pain threshold than me.
ex.zh: 我哥哥比我耐疼得多。

ex.en: Raising the income threshold for financial assistance would allow more low-paid workers to receive support.
ex.zh: 提高经济援助的收入门槛，将使更多低薪劳动者能够获得支持。

col: on the threshold of｜即将进入
tip: on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。

senses.en: A reptile with a protective shell, often living in water.

ex.en: We watched a turtle swimming slowly over the reef.
ex.zh: 我们看着一只海龟在珊瑚礁上方缓缓游动。

ex.en: Reducing plastic pollution in coastal waters is essential for protecting turtle populations and other marine wildlife.
ex.zh: 减少沿海水域的塑料污染，对保护海龟种群及其他海洋野生动物至关重要。

tip: 英式turtle多指海龟；陆龟通常叫tortoise。

senses.en: To judge something as less important, capable, or large than reality
An estimate that is lower than the actual amount

ex.en: We underestimated the traffic and arrived half an hour late.
ex.zh: 我们低估了交通拥堵程度，结果迟到了半小时。

ex.en: Policymakers should not underestimate the long-term effects of poor housing on children's health and educational achievement.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应低估恶劣住房条件对儿童健康和学业表现的长期影响。

col: underestimate the importance of｜低估……的重要性
tip: 动词末尾读/ meɪt /，名词末尾读/ mət /。

senses.en: causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious
lying beneath the surface of something

ex.en: The mechanic found the underlying cause of the noise.
ex.zh: 机械师找到了异响的根本原因。

ex.en: Addressing the underlying causes of poverty requires sustained investment in education, healthcare, and secure employment.
ex.zh: 解决贫困的根本原因需要持续投资于教育、医疗和稳定就业。

tip: 通常放在名词前，强调表面现象背后的原因或基础。

senses.en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.
A formal promise to do something.

ex.en: Renovating this old house is a much bigger undertaking.
ex.zh: 翻修这栋老房子是一项艰巨得多的任务。

ex.en: Building a nationwide railway network is a major undertaking that requires sustained investment and careful planning.
ex.zh: 建设全国性铁路网是一项重大工程，需要持续投资和周密规划。

col: a joint undertaking｜共同承担的项目
give an undertaking｜作出正式承诺
tip: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。

senses.en: not level, flat, or smooth
not equal or regular in amount, quality, or distribution

ex.en: Watch your step on the uneven stones outside.
ex.zh: 外面的石头高低不平，走路时要小心。

ex.en: Uneven access to digital technology can widen educational inequalities between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 获取数字技术的机会不均等，可能扩大城乡社区之间的教育差距。

tip: 奇数用odd，不用uneven；uneven强调不平或不均。

senses.en: Never having happened or existed before.

ex.en: The bakery received an unprecedented flood of orders today.
ex.zh: 今天这家面包店收到了空前大量的订单。

ex.en: Many coastal communities face unprecedented challenges as rising sea levels threaten homes, infrastructure, and local livelihoods.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升威胁住房、基础设施和当地生计，许多沿海社区面临前所未有的挑战。

col: on an unprecedented scale｜以空前的规模
tip: 强调从未发生过，不只是程度很大或不常见。

senses.en: Likely to move, fall, or collapse.
Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably.

ex.en: This unstable chair wobbles whenever I sit on it.
ex.zh: 这把椅子不稳，我一坐上去就晃。

ex.en: An unstable economy can discourage investment and make long-term planning difficult for small businesses.
ex.zh: 经济不稳定会抑制投资，并使小企业难以制定长期计划。

tip: 可指物体不稳，也可指经济、局势等易变。

senses.zh: （法律上的）有效；符合逻辑，正确

senses.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.

ex.en: My sister became a vegetarian after learning to cook.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学会做饭后成了一名素食者。

ex.en: Providing vegetarian meals in school canteens can accommodate different dietary preferences and reduce environmental impacts.
ex.zh: 学校食堂提供素食可以满足不同的饮食偏好，并减少对环境的影响。

tip: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

senses.en: an act that breaks a law, rule, or agreement
an act that disregards someone's rights or privacy

ex.en: Parking across this entrance is a clear violation.
ex.zh: 把车停在这个入口处显然是违规行为。

ex.en: Collecting personal information without consent may constitute a violation of privacy, even when the data remains confidential.
ex.zh: 未经同意收集个人信息，即使数据仍被保密，也可能构成对隐私的侵犯。

col: a violation of the law｜违法行为
a violation of privacy｜侵犯隐私
tip: 用a violation of表示违反或侵犯某事物。

senses.en: Easily harmed, attacked, or negatively affected.

ex.en: Young plants are vulnerable to frost on cold nights.
ex.zh: 幼苗在寒冷的夜晚容易遭受霜冻。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide additional support for vulnerable residents during periods of extreme heat.
ex.zh: 在极端高温期间，地方政府应为易受影响的居民提供额外支持。

tip: 常用 vulnerable to，to 后接名词。

senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

senses.en: to think about something you do not know
a feeling of surprise and admiration
something unusually impressive or surprising

ex.en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
ex.zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。

ex.en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
ex.zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

tip: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

senses.en: The amount of work someone must complete within a particular period.

ex.en: My workload doubled when two colleagues went on holiday.
ex.zh: 两位同事休假后，我的工作量增加了一倍。

ex.en: Employers should monitor staff workload carefully to prevent stress and maintain the quality of their services.
ex.zh: 雇主应密切关注员工的工作量，以预防压力并维持服务质量。

tip: 工作量大用heavy workload，而非hard workload。

senses.en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.

ex.en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
ex.zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。

ex.en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
ex.zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。

col: work as a receptionist｜担任接待员
tip: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。

senses.en: able to spread disease between people or organisms
causing others to share the same feeling or behaviour

ex.en: His infectious laugh soon had everyone at the table smiling.
ex.zh: 他富有感染力的笑声很快让桌边的每个人都笑了起来。

ex.en: Improved sanitation and access to clean water are essential for preventing infectious diseases in densely populated communities.
ex.zh: 改善卫生条件并保障清洁用水，对预防人口密集社区的传染病至关重要。

tip: infectious表示有传染性；infected表示已被感染。

senses.en: To take in and fully understand new information or ideas.
To become, or make someone become, part of a cultural group.

ex.en: I need time to assimilate everything we learned today.
ex.zh: 我需要时间消化今天所学的所有内容。

ex.en: Students assimilate new information more effectively when teachers connect unfamiliar concepts with examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 教师将陌生概念与日常生活中的例子联系起来时，学生能更有效地吸收新知识。

tip: 知识可直接作宾语；融入群体常用into。

senses.en: the ability to solve problems in clever, original ways

ex.en: With some ingenuity, Lina turned old crates into shelves.
ex.zh: 莉娜巧妙地把旧板条箱改成了架子。

ex.en: Human ingenuity can help communities develop affordable solutions to water shortages using locally available materials.
ex.zh: 人类的巧思能帮助社区利用当地材料，开发经济实惠的缺水应对方案。

col: a feat of ingenuity｜独具匠心的成就
tip: 对应形容词ingenious；别与意为天真的ingenuous混淆。

senses.en: make or become steady and less likely to change

ex.en: We used a wooden block to stabilize the table.
ex.zh: 我们用一块木块让桌子保持平稳。

ex.en: Governments may need to stabilize food prices to protect vulnerable households during periods of economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 在经济不确定时期，政府可能需要稳定食品价格，以保护弱势家庭。

col: stabilize a patient's condition｜稳定患者病情
tip: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。
